.DQbtn{display:grid;grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(90px, 1fr));grid-auto-flow: dense;gap: 5px;}

{{#if:{{#varexists:防止多次加载CSS}}||{{#vardefineecho:防止多次加载CSS|{{#tag:bstyle|
.btn-default {background: url(https://patchwiki.biligame.com/images/seer/0/0c/3c70xama0pgym9t19ffaxujp2llacls.png) !important;background-size: 100% 100% !important;margin-right: 6px !important;color: #ffffff;}
.btn{border: none !important;border-radius: 0px;}
.btn-default.active, .btn-default:active, .open>.dropdown-toggle.btn-default {background: url(https://patchwiki.biligame.com/images/seer/c/cc/79rcvuiqcmdity4nzk1k3uvesrt6ktf.png)!important;border-radius: 0 !important;color: #ffffff !important;background-size: 100% 100% !important;}
.btn-default:hover {color: #333;background-color: #e6e6e6;border-color: #adadad;background: url(https://patchwiki.biligame.com/images/seer/c/cc/79rcvuiqcmdity4nzk1k3uvesrt6ktf.png)!important;border-radius: 0 !important;color: #ffffff !important;background-size: 100% 100% !important;}
li.btn.queryParams.selected {background: url(https://patchwiki.biligame.com/images/seer/c/cc/79rcvuiqcmdity4nzk1k3uvesrt6ktf.png)!important;border-radius: 0 !important;color: #ffffff !important;background-size: 100% 100% !important;-webkit-box-shadow: none;box-shadow: none;}
span#queryDataBtn {background: url(https://patchwiki.biligame.com/images/seer/9/9b/39fad2ju6h32vfr0lhdqukikz7hs7r3.png) !important;background-size: 100% 100% !important;margin-right: 6px !important;}
span#queryDataBtn:hover {background: url(https://patchwiki.biligame.com/images/seer/c/cf/ckxusxyerridsml55dpoldablgpttxo.png) !important; background-size: 100% 100% !important;margin-right: 6px !important;}


.divsort {display: flex;align-items: center;gap: 10px;padding: 4px 8px;font-family: "Segoe UI", sans-serif;border-bottom: 1px solid #333;background: #0a0a0a;color: #eee;width: 100%;}
.divsort .d {min-width: 40px;text-align: center;font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;}
.divsort .d:nth-child(2) { min-width: 100px; } /* 精灵名 */
.divsort .d:nth-child(3) { min-width: 80px;  } /* 属性图标+文字 */
.divsort .total {color: #ffcc00;font-weight: bold;}
.divsort {display: flex;align-items: center;border-bottom: 1px solid #555;      /* 行线 */}
.divsort .d {min-width: 40px;text-align: center;font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;padding: 4px 6px;border-right: 1px solid #444;    width: 50%;       /* 列线 */}
.divsort .d:last-child { border-right: none; } /* 最后一列去掉多余竖线 */
.divsort {    width: 100%;background: rgb(19 19 19 / 69%);color: #ffffff;}
.divsort#title {    background: rgb(19 19 19 / 91%);    font-weight: bold;}
}}}}}}
